mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is declining (t-test p > 0.05) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline (over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index exceeds 200, it signals elevated inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 200 (over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO is rising (t-test p > 0.05) over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 2100 thousand units, it signals a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 2100 (over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% and a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a dual shock of labor market weakness and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5 (over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market weakness reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0 (over 3-year rolling window).
